name: Midsummer House
dinnerNote: Solstice menu (Corpus £175, Trinity £135; Grand Siècle Solstice with Champagne £285)

menus.name: Solstice menu
menus.note: The signature tasting menu. Dinner Wednesday to Saturday, lunch Thursday to Saturday. With a glass of Laurent-Perrier Grand Siècle Champagne it becomes the Grand Siècle Solstice menu, £285. Wine flights from £135 (a review of an April 2025 dinner; the restaurant doesn't publish its flight prices)
menus.plus: plus a £19.50 cheese course if taken

menus.name: Corpus menu
menus.note: Dishes from the restaurant's history. Lunch Wednesday to Saturday, dinner Wednesday to Friday

menus.name: Trinity menu
menus.note: A shorter set menu. Lunch Wednesday to Saturday, dinner Wednesday to Friday

bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable or by phone. The calendar opens three months ahead, on the 1st of each month at 9am. To confirm, a card must be verified through a link sent by email and text, which places a hold on it.
cancellation: Cancel at least 48 hours ahead at no charge. Later cancellations, and guests dropping out within 48 hours, are charged the full price of the chosen menu.
waitlist: Email reservations@midsummerhouse.co.uk to join the waiting list for a fully booked date, or to be reminded when bookings open for a date.
groups: The first-floor private dining room takes up to 14, choosing from the same three menus; parties under seven pay for seven menus, with a £100 a head deposit and a seven-day cancellation period. The whole restaurant (up to 45 seated, plus 14 in the private room) can be hired.
children: Children aged 12 and over only in the main restaurant, with no children's menu and no room for pushchairs. Younger children are welcome in the private dining room.
byob: Guests can't bring their own wine.
